text:
mira: opened PR #512 for Dedicated Capacity docs. TL;DR: clarify autoscale min/max units to weight-based, sync SDK examples to client.capacity.allocate(), fix SLA prose to 99.95, replace broken eviction link, and add isolation annotation example. reviewers please quick review.
tony: on it. Where is the SLA mismatch?
mira: intro paragraph says 99.9 but examples and TF show 99.95.
rachael: my bad, i'll update the prose.
liam: for autoscale samples i propose weight units: min=0.25-wg, max=12-wg, and a one-line footnote mapping 1.0-wg ~= 1 standard vGPU (model-dependent). add CLI and TF snippets side-by-side.
tony: add migration note: "Migrated pools keep existing weights unless reset_weights=true."
mira: good. rachel can you also swap the old k8s blog link to our eviction behavior doc?
rachael: done in the branch. also fixed the SDK call to client.capacity.allocate() and left a deprecated comment for the old call.
docs-bot: Reminder: PR #512 needs two reviewers.
tony: LGTM after tiny grammar fix. approving.
liam: approved.
docs-bot: CI: actions/docs-build success (build 214).
mira: merged. will add changelog note.
docs-bot: Thread archived.
